meta.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

meta.name: The Guiding Light
meta.short_description: The Guiding Light is a single-player action RPG with pixel heroes and a 3D fantasy world. Choose Warrior, Mage, Tank, Archer, or Swordsman; master unique skills, explore villages and dungeons, and defeat foes and bosses. Find your fighting style, grow stronger, and light the way home.

meta.name: The Big Suck
meta.short_description: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and turn destruction into upgrades. Start with a blade of grass. Keep growing until you tear the planet apart.

meta.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
meta.short_description: ART NOIRE: Paris: a relaxing, atmospheric ring puzzle game in romantic 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings in 50 picture puzzles. Enjoy elegant film noir art, soothing music and a shift from black and white to full color. Play solo with a mouse.

meta.name: Autistic Romance
meta.short_description: What makes divorce a justified decision? Does it even need to be justified? Each night, choose who to spend your time with. Decide what you believe about relationships at 'The End' of this visual novel.

meta.name: Funeral for the Sun
meta.short_description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

meta.name: Music Manager
meta.short_description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

meta.name: Project: Haste
meta.short_description: Break in. Tear it up. Get out before the cops show up. Wall run, slide, double jump and rocket-jump off your own shotgun across places you don't belong. Headshot your friends mid-air and chain eliminations in a lightning-fast 4-player arena shooter you can pick up in a single match.

5405460.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic

meta.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
meta.short_description: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

meta.name: Hunter Bro VR
meta.short_description: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Use a rifle, play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt or set the woods on fire with your flamethrower

meta.name: Idle Camp Tale
meta.short_description: A fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

meta.name: Fablery
meta.short_description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

meta.name: Abracademia
meta.short_description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

meta.name: Gnart's Escape
meta.short_description: To escape the maze, you must survive turn-based combats in which cards will activate your weapons, and they will perform according to dice rolls. Gnart's Escape is a Deck-building Roguelike RPG.

meta.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
meta.short_description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

meta.name: March and Conquer
meta.short_description: March and Conquer is a short autobattler game. During the battle, use the skill tree to train units to fight against enemies on the battlefield. Gain gold and mana from wins and train different units and upgrade your army. March across multiple lands and fight fearsome foes!

meta.name: Cardalaxy
meta.short_description: 4X distilled into a card game with 5 different ways to win.

meta.name: Slimies
meta.short_description: Slimies is a top-down action roguelike where you evolve and absorb waves of enemies, growing stronger after each round. Craft your own playstyle by unlocking slimes and items to make a unique build each run.

meta.name: Tricolo
meta.short_description: A minimalist logic puzzle played on a 3×3 grid. Take on 200+ puzzles built around simple rules and intuitive controls.

meta.name: Seferia Matrix
meta.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

meta.name: Path to Catakombs
meta.short_description: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

meta.name: Eye of Darkness
meta.short_description: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.

meta.name: REC:REWIND
meta.short_description: Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him. Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

meta.name: 1999TOKOYO Building
meta.short_description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

meta.name: The Staring Man | 凝視男
meta.short_description: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

meta.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
meta.short_description: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.

meta.name: Cards of Bellum
meta.short_description: Master the Deck & overthrow the King in this roguelike tabletop deckbuilder featuring strategy, dice and a little luck. Dominate suit-based combat with strength-boosting dice, or recruit and use unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights.

meta.name: Your account has been banned
meta.short_description: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

meta.name: Pidgeon Pocket

meta.name: Tidy Up Mall
meta.short_description: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 5,000 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

meta.name: Go Next!
meta.short_description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

meta.name: Masyu: Line Logic
meta.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. meta.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
meta.short_description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

meta.name: Corgi Race Live
meta.short_description: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.

meta.name: Picronix 2
meta.short_description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

meta.name: Supercar Collection Together
meta.short_description: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

meta.name: Bouncemetry
meta.short_description: An incremental game made of seven physics simulations. Drop balls into a ring until it shatters, steal links on a gravity-free lattice, sweep a reactor with a beam. Upgrades change the physics itself, and automated simulations keep earning while you work on the next one.

meta.name: What the Buck?!
meta.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

meta.name: Tiny Village
meta.short_description: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!

meta.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
meta.short_description: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

meta.name: Fraga
meta.short_description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

meta.name: Megachest
meta.short_description: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

meta.name: Rocket.io
meta.short_description: Rocket.io is an online multiplayer arena game where hover-cars battle for territory. Leave a trail, claim ground, and cut off your rivals! Play quick matches, private rooms, and battles with 2 to 8 teams, or take on the AI. Collect and customize over 25 vehicles.

meta.name: Score Circuit
meta.short_description: Chain risky scoring nodes, cash out before the circuit burns out, and unlock 80 modifiers that bend every run. Score Circuit is a compact neon score-attack roguelite about one more carefully calculated push.

meta.name: Mazehold
meta.short_description: Build the maze. Hold the keep. A tower defense roguelite without waves: wall in an endless horde across 7 worlds, combine 15 towers into 104 combos, draft cards as you level up – and survive 20 minutes until the final boss marches on your castle.

meta.name: Gotching
meta.short_description: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

meta.name: Gilded Shoals
meta.short_description: A relaxing incremental fishing game with short voyages and lasting upgrades. Explore five coastal locations, chase rare catches and Golden Shoals, and build a living aquarium with unlockable backdrops and freely placed decorations.

meta.name: Shai & Shatta
meta.short_description: Run a lively Egyptian street kitchen solo or with friends. Brew shai, build ful sandwiches, and master koshary as orders pile up and the neighborhood causes chaos. Cook with up to 4 players locally or 8 online.

meta.name: Twin-stick Japanese
meta.short_description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

meta.name: Menthal
meta.short_description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

meta.name: Mini Battleships
meta.short_description: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. meta.name: Oboro no Ichi
meta.short_description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

meta.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid

meta.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
meta.short_description: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.

meta.name: Palisade

meta.name: The Horror

meta.name: Flowers to Honey
meta.short_description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

meta.name: Frankenmine

meta.name: Journey Under The Pyramids

meta.name: Backrooms: 1977

meta.name: Mediotorum

meta.name: Subnautica

meta.name: Don't Starve

meta.name: Slay the Spire

meta.name: Big Dig

meta.name: Captain of Industry

meta.name: Rain World
meta.short_description: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

meta.name: Tensei Brave

meta.name: Tiny Eden

meta.name: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip

meta.name: AI Olympius

meta.name: Slime Rancher

meta.name: Go-Go Town!

meta.name: Windblown

meta.name: The Witch's Bakery

meta.name: Hubble Bubble

meta.name: Yarimono

meta.name: Legion Breaker

meta.name: Little Nightmares II

meta.name: Gang Beasts

meta.name: Mouthwashing

meta.name: Out of the Park Baseball 27

meta.short_description: The Gold River Project™ is a camping trip gone wrong in the Pacific Northwest. Explore, craft, build, and survive in this open-world experiment that traps you and up to 4 friends in this single player or co-op survival adventure game.

meta.name: Unrailed!
meta.short_description: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!

spy.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access

meta.name: Stoneshard
meta.short_description: Stoneshard is a hardcore turn-based RPG about the harsh life of a medieval mercenary: travel with your own caravan, descend into procedurally generated dungeons, learn new skills, survive hunger and injuries - and remember, every mistake can mean death and loss of progress.

meta.name: Normal Golf Game
meta.short_description: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

meta.name: Sandustry
meta.short_description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Racing, Early Access

meta.name: One Way Tickets
meta.short_description: “One Way Tickets” is a roguelite incremental adventure game where you embark on a exciting journey in a fantasy world. Choose your vehicle, equip your device and face challenges from all kinds of enemies. Ram! Unload bullets! Swing with all your might! Keep growing and push forward!

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports

meta.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
meta.short_description: A 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.

meta.name: Lost Castle 2
meta.short_description: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

meta.name: Airport Security Sucks!
meta.short_description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.

spy.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access

meta.name: Travellers Rest
meta.short_description: Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters.

meta.name: Megastore Simulator
meta.short_description: Megastore Simulator is a first-person management & tycoon game. Choose your starting department and build a massive two-floor megastore! Unlock 1,000+ unique products across 11 departments, from clothing to butchery. Hire staff and manage warehouse logistics with forklifts and pallet jacks.

meta.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
meta.short_description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Free To Play, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG

meta.name: The Spike Cross
meta.short_description: "The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?" Developed by an indie developer who loves volleyball! The sports game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

meta.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
meta.short_description: The threequel to the party game phenomenon features the deadly quiz show Trivia Murder Party, the say-anything sequel Quiplash 2, the surprising survey game Guesspionage, the t-shirt slugfest Tee K.O., and the sneaky trickster game Fakin’ It.

meta.name: Voidtrain
meta.short_description: Become a crew member of an Interdimensional Express Train! Discover a new world full of mysterious creatures, enemies and places. Upgrade and customize your train, gather new materials and build better weapons. Play solo or online сo-op with up to 4 people.

meta.name: Airborne Kingdom
meta.short_description: The sky city builder awaits. Create your own flying kingdom and lead it on a quest across an expansive world. Explore the varied landscape, build up a floating metropolis, aid struggling people below, uncover lost secrets and, ultimately, bring back the Airborne Kingdom legend.

meta.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
meta.short_description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

meta.name: Road to Empress Ⅱ
meta.short_description: Play as the protagonist in this live-action interactive palace survival drama! Take a dynasty's fate into your own hands in Road to Empress II, the new content of the global hit. Defy fate, navigate intrigue, and claim the throne of power. You decide it all!

meta.name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
meta.short_description: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

meta.name: Date Everything!
meta.short_description: Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

meta.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
meta.short_description: Enjoy action-packed flashy combat with incredibly satisfying combos and responsive controls! Numerous characters, each with completely unique playstyles and loads of unlockable moves & upgrades! This action roguelike sets the bar for fluid fast-paced action.

meta.name: Birb
meta.short_description: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

meta.name: Megabonk
meta.short_description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Grab loot, level up, unlock characters and upgrade to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!

meta.name: Gross Survivors
meta.short_description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

meta.name: Give Us Back Gravity
meta.short_description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

meta.name: Village of the Mirror
meta.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

meta.name: Prism Core
meta.short_description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

meta.name: +PROTECTUS-
meta.short_description: 🧲 A minimalist first‑person puzzle game where you have to escape from a ruined lunar complex using an experimental magnetic cannon and uncover the secrets of the ECHO project together with the drone Kruitni.

meta.name: Elya
meta.short_description: Raise a desktop companion in a cozy single-player pet game. Chat, build your bond, collect memories, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Workshop creations.

meta.name: Hazard Crew
meta.short_description: A first-person bodycam horror game, 1-4 player co-op about scavenging. Explore a procedurally generated maze of empty rooms for Hazard Recovery Co., collecting objects graded on rarity. Every corridor is a choice: leave with something ordinary, or go deeper in the dark for something worth more.

meta.name: River Secret
meta.short_description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

meta.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
meta.short_description: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

meta.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
meta.short_description: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

meta.name: The Third Seal
meta.short_description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

meta.name: Gimby
meta.short_description: Guard the Skull and Crown of the dead King of the Underworld. Explore, hunt, fish and build by day, then hold your tower against the horde each night.

meta.name: Excids: Endless Siege
meta.short_description: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

5373170.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless

meta.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless
meta.short_description: Walk through Claude Monet's paintings as a Great War veteran carrying his wife's ashes to the sea. Stop, look closer, and paint color back into the world he lost. A quiet, wordless pilgrimage where stillness is rewarded.

meta.name: 单机斗地主
meta.short_description: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

meta.name: Untitled Maze Game
meta.short_description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird guy.cs this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

meta.name: Outcast Tales
meta.short_description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

meta.name: Adultery Marriage Punisher
meta.short_description: "Adultery Marriage Punisher" Curing marriage pests! Investigate. Infiltrate. Snap. Spy. Steal. Outwit. What is your spouse doing behind your back? Your evidence, the deadliest sanction. Now, become the shadow of justice, and unveil every betrayal and infidelity!

meta.name: Taskbar Parade
meta.short_description: A desktop companion game: a tiny parade of cute animals walks along the top of your taskbar while you work. Pet them, catch sparkles on the road, grant their daily wishes, send them exploring, and collect hats, friends and souvenirs. Quiet by default — it never gets in the way.

5005180.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move

meta.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
meta.short_description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

meta.name: Grim Guild
meta.short_description: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back. Streaming? Name newcomers after your viewers.

meta.name: TRAPPIST-1
meta.short_description: A short sci-fi horror game. Extract energy from a red dwarf, tune signals, and power distant worlds. Do your job. Don't ask what really keeps the station running.

meta.name: Picpic
meta.short_description: Sharp eyes. Fast combos. Fierce rivals. Picpic is an anime-style spot-the-difference PvP game. Find differences before your opponent, rack up combo scores, and attack to disrupt their play. Keep your focus as the clock ticks down!

meta.name: DOOM MATES
meta.short_description: An online multiplayer horror for up to 5 players. One of you is the hunter, and the rest have to work together to escape strange places. No two runs are the same, because these places always change. Create your own jumpscare and watch your friends run into it in the dark!

meta.name: Mahjong Rush
meta.short_description: A single-player mahjong roguelike with an ink-wash art style. Make runs and sets from your tiles to score points — complete a winning hand and your score multiplies. Buy Flower cards, talismans and treasures to get stronger.. Never played mahjong? A step-by-step tutorial gets you started.

meta.name: Only Luck
meta.short_description: Five sixes is a 1 in 7776 roll. How about 1 in 10? Only Luck is a pixel-art dice clicker: click to charge your throw, toss up to 9 dice, collect 1100 rare combinations and earn prestige chips. Upgrade your table, spin the Wheel of Luck and bend the rules until the impossible roll becomes routine.

meta.name: History Experience: Rome
meta.short_description: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

meta.name: Operator: Observation
meta.short_description: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

meta.name: Tetheg
meta.short_description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

meta.name: Spook & Sell
meta.short_description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

meta.name: Change
meta.short_description: Atmospheric simulator of the seller in a night stall of the 1993 model. Immerse yourself in the melancholy of the sleeping area: sell goods, count the change and communicate with customers.

meta.name: Adventurer 95
meta.short_description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

meta.name: Tilt Rivals
meta.short_description: Fast-paced pinball meets head-to-head competition. Challenge rivals online, face a friend in local PvP or take on the CPU solo. Defend your goal, unleash power-ups and survive double-ball chaos across unlockable arenas. One more point. One more rematch.

meta.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
meta.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

meta.name: Demonfall Continent
developers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
meta.short_description: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.

meta.name: Memory Access Violation
meta.short_description: A first-person dream in rectangular prisms. Wander 37 corrupted memories of light and geometry: bend light through prisms, recall platforms that aren't there, ride a light cycle, and face the Warden, a giant soldier the war forgot.

meta.name: Nitro Nonsense
meta.short_description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!

meta.name: One More Brick
meta.short_description: A cozy incremental brick breaker on a scribbled sketchbook page. Smash bricks, collect the rewards, and buy upgrades until balls split, lasers fly, and the page gets wonderfully messy. Grow your skill tree, put the Infinite Breaker to work, and turn over a new page.

meta.name: Project Nekrios
meta.short_description: A co-op sci-fi horror shooter for 1–4 players. Hold a derelict space station against endless waves of aliens: weld the barricades shut, haul in salvage with tractor beams, restore power, and build new rooms, weapons and upgrades to survive one more round.

meta.name: Chain of Command
meta.short_description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

meta.name: Flipping Phantom
meta.short_description: A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

meta.name: Zanoka
meta.short_description: ZANOKA is a single-player roguelike action hack and slash and survivorlike where every sword swing is yours. Chain light and heavy cuts into combos, time your dodges and combine elemental upgrades against enemy waves and bosses. Every run is different, and every run can reveal a new build.

meta.name: wishbound
meta.short_description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

meta.name: Leikkaus
meta.short_description: One student, one abandoned university, and someone who is after their benefits... or more. Hide. Run. Don't get cut.

meta.name: Beast Hunt
meta.short_description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

meta.name: Jewel Reels
meta.short_description: Build a little workshop into a jewel-clearing machine. Pull the reels, set off colorful chain reactions, combine clever accessories, and invest your coins to conquer eight contracts. Keep building after victory or retire to begin again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.

meta.name: Climb for Kittens
meta.short_description: Build your way up a giant tree to rescue stranded kittens! Craft and connect different objects, create your own climbing paths, and overcome tricky heights. Every rescued kitten unlocks new building materials. Build higher, don't fall, and save them all!

meta.name: The Circus That Never Left
meta.short_description: Step inside a circus performer's quiet home, but don't stop at the surface. In this short-form descent into dread, follow a hidden labyrinth deep beneath the floorboards and watch a simple investigation spiral into a claustrophobic nightmare.

meta.name: Galactic Bounty
meta.short_description: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

meta.name: Arcana
meta.short_description: A poker roguelike with cheating bosses. Build hands, chain chips and multipliers with 21 arcana and face ten bosses who break the rules, all the way to THE JAILER, who keeps souls inside his deck.

meta.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
meta.short_description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

meta.name: The Gassal
meta.short_description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

meta.name: Giggleland
meta.short_description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

meta.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
meta.short_description: CALVAR – THE DARKEST GATE is a first-person psychological horror game created by a two-person indie team. Explore a world of fractured memories, ritual corruption, disturbing creatures, and an abandoned asylum where reality itself begins to unravel.

meta.name: Hot Mic
meta.short_description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

meta.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
meta.short_description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

meta.name: Jarkeeper
meta.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

meta.name: Stay with me
meta.short_description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

meta.name: Seven Doors
meta.short_description: Seven Doors is a first-person horror game set in a mysterious world that resembles Korea's Joseon Dynasty. Explore dark and unsettling places, uncover hidden clues, and find a way to escape while hiding and running from terrifying entities lurking in the darkness.

meta.name: Cardtographer
meta.short_description: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

4742590.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar

meta.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar
meta.short_description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

4755440.name: Maximilien — A Psychological Horror Interactive Novel

meta.name: Maximilien — A Psychological Horror Interactive Novel
meta.short_description: A psychological horror interactive novel, Boston 1926. Explore, investigate, lose your footing. Your choices shape a branching story, while your mental state distorts the very page you read. 4 intersecting routes, 12 possible endings, 2 to 5 hours per playthrough.

meta.name: Wild Heroes: Fight Together
meta.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in an online co-op action roguelite. Carve a path into the living Wild, battle monster packs in bramble arenas, topple three colossal bosses and come back stronger after every expedition.

meta.name: Eternal Chamber
meta.short_description: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

5062910.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.

meta.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
meta.short_description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

meta.name: ShredDead
meta.short_description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

meta.name: Gacha Chaos Tidy Up Together
meta.short_description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and SLAP capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

meta.name: Night Drive - Anomaly
meta.short_description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

meta.name: TOWERTOWER
meta.short_description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

meta.name: How to Summon a Demon
meta.short_description: Ready to summon a demon this Halloween? Three answers decide which of 20 demons answers your call. A short, fully voiced summoning ritual with a collection book for everyone who wants to summon them all!

meta.name: The Spectacular Evermore
meta.short_description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

4895300.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal

meta.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
meta.short_description: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

meta.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind
meta.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

meta.name: SORT THEM ALPACAS: OVERLOAD!
meta.short_description: Sort 5,000 alpaca plushies in a first-person collectathon with a touch of chaos. Spend your sorting earnings on a deep upgrade system, and discover five hidden powers with chaotic upgrades of their own.

meta.name: Gorgeous Baby Bella
meta.short_description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

meta.name: Terms of Service
meta.short_description: Terms of Service is a short first-person psychological horror game where you answer 100 increasingly invasive Yes/No questions at an old CRT terminal. As the form becomes more cursed, disturbing memories bleed through the screen, the CRT deteriorates, and the agreement starts to feel less voluntary.

meta.name: Timeless Rain
meta.short_description: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

meta.name: Night Plane
meta.short_description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

meta.name: Spooky Market
meta.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

meta.name: Space Savory
meta.short_description: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

meta.name: Scopa Sweep
meta.short_description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

meta.name: Punch Upon a Time
meta.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

meta.name: Skullf!
meta.short_description: Sure, we've all had fun in a graveyard, but have you ever tried macabre mini-golf amongst the tombstones?! Well NOW YOU CAN with SKULLF! Help your disembodied skull of terror into its grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs & go head-to-head with friends (friends not included) across 44+ fiendish levels!

meta.name: Visa Quest
