meta.short_description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

meta.name: Monster Hatcher
meta.short_description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

meta.name: Rouge Process
meta.short_description: An AI is loose in the machine. Spread your code across a neon circuit board, seize compute and hold off the antivirus. A real-time roguelite of territory and tower defense: capture data, build and upgrade subroutines, dive through 20 sectors and destroy the Kernel to escape.

meta.name: ROMUL
meta.short_description: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

meta.name: Rogue Links
meta.short_description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

meta.name: Better World
meta.short_description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

meta.name: RIA 26
meta.short_description: Enter the storm-covered desert arena of RIA 26 and fight to be the last buggy standing. Battle rival drivers with cannons, rockets, mortars and mines, collect weapons, and master the terrain. Complete Wasteland Contracts, earn XP, level up your career, and Play solo or over LAN.

meta.name: Iskabon
meta.short_description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

meta.name: Deep Frost
meta.short_description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

meta.name: Arctic Roll
meta.short_description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

meta.name: Pucked Up
meta.short_description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

meta.name: Anime Shop Chaos: Tidy Up!
meta.short_description: Collect scattered character parts, assemble 10 big anime figures on their stands, and watch them wave when complete. Organize 5,000 mini figures across 25 collections in this cozy first-person tidying game. Earn upgrades and turn a chaotic shop into your collector's paradise.

meta.name: Cloud JourneyVR
meta.short_description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

meta.name: Gravity Miner
meta.short_description: A PS1-style first-person mining roguelite inside a floating cube of a million blocks. Shift gravity to walk on any wall, dig for ore before your oxygen runs out, dodge buried bombs and hatching monsters, and haul 100 diamonds back to base.

meta.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Complete
meta.short_description: Piece together cozy places, beautiful paintings and your own photos. Fill optional story and travel albums, or choose any picture and puzzle at your own pace. Play solo, with friends online, or across your Windows desktop.

meta.name: Task Bar Isekai
meta.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

meta.name: Pickie Grappy
meta.short_description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

meta.name: Dying Patience
meta.short_description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

meta.name: Gnomes Vs Knights
meta.short_description: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

meta.name: Anomaly Center
meta.short_description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

meta.name: BUZZ or DIE
meta.short_description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

meta.name: Ember Reaches
meta.short_description: A single-player pixel-art idle RPG. Gather supplies, craft equipment, reconnect nine realms and explore 27 ruins. Face six dragons through battle or covenant, help the settlements along the road, and decide the fate of a broken celestial ring.

meta.name: Pawnie: Focus Pals
meta.short_description: Pawnie: Focus Pals is a productivity desktop companion. Pawnie lives on top of Windows and acts as a reflection of the user's effort, promoting focus and well-being through a positive reinforcement system and environment personalization.

meta.name: Picofender
meta.short_description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

meta.name: Skysunder
meta.short_description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

meta.name: Tarpit
meta.short_description: Tarpit is a psychological indie horror game where you have to make TAR to rescue your friend from danger. Beware of the forces in your surroundings. The forces definitely see you... but do you see them?

meta.name: Tsukumo SNAP!
meta.short_description: Every forgotten thing grows a soul. Photograph them with your grandma's ancient flip phone, befriend 161 spirits, and spin them into battle. A comedy monster-collecting RPG in a Japanese town that changes with the real calendar.

meta.name: Mandela Invasion: Alternates
meta.short_description: Found tapes depict events leading to mysterious disappearances and murders with no clear culprit. With no more evidence than a couple of emergency calls describing unusual behavior in certain people who appear mostly human, you will relive these VHS tapes to uncover the events.

meta.name: Cozy Associations
meta.short_description: A cozy card puzzle about finding what belongs together. Match words and pictures, gather them into categories, and tidy up the board. Get comfy with 100 levels, 10 charming settings, and a little daily puzzle just for you.

meta.name: Zeitnot
meta.short_description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

meta.name: Metal Detector Simulator
meta.short_description: Sweep the coil, listen for the beep and dig up everything from bottle caps to pirate gold. Sell your finds, upgrade your gear, clean up six beaches to bring the crowds back, and hunt for the Captain's Chest in this relaxing first-person treasure hunting game.

meta.name: Prismarch
meta.short_description: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy as you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities, and there's no limit to the size of your roster! Before you stand 7 prismatic kings, each wielding an element of power. Slay them, and ascend the throne!

meta.name: Flipocalypse
meta.short_description: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

meta.name: Shift Chess
meta.short_description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

meta.name: Portolan
meta.short_description: Build your trading company in the 16th-century Age of Discovery. Trade goods across global ports, plan profitable routes, and manage voyages and automated fleets in this text-based trading and management simulation.

meta.name: Rate & State
meta.short_description: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

meta.name: Ascended Snake
meta.short_description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

meta.name: PACKING SHIFT
meta.short_description: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

meta.name: Rushmark
meta.short_description: Your dash is your weapon. On the ground it's back in under a second. In the air you get one, and only a kill buys another. A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer: wall-kick, chain and strike through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs, then race any rival's ghost off the leaderboard.

meta.name: Anywhere RPG
meta.short_description: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

meta.name: Asylium
meta.short_description: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

meta.name: Goddle
meta.short_description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

4275140.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs

meta.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
meta.short_description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

meta.name: Pit Purge
meta.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

4951060.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand

meta.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
meta.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

meta.name: Bathroom Please!
meta.short_description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

meta.name: Squall Riders
meta.short_description: Jet-ski racing where every swell is a ramp. Launch off storm waves, land tricks to charge your boost and outrace four rivals through three storms. Then take on Stunt Park, Splash Ball, Slalom and Big Wave, earn Spray and build your own ski in the garage.

meta.name: RunGun Riot
meta.short_description: Drop into a neon 2D battle royale. Choose your fighter, scavenge weapons and gear, and fight across rooftops, interiors and underground routes. Use class abilities, break through cover, and stay ahead of the storm to outlast the riot.

meta.name: FRUIT CATCH: TWO BASKETS
meta.short_description: Catch the right fruit with two baskets! Play with a friend and control one basket each, or take on both baskets alone for a fast-paced multitasking challenge.

meta.name: EvilTrap
meta.short_description: EvilTrap is set in a cursed village where an endless night forces you to seek fleeting refuge. Hunted by something that listens and remembers, you will quickly learn that a deep evil consumes this place. Hide, survive, and find a way out.

meta.name: TCG Card Chaos
meta.short_description: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.

meta.name: Shadow Gangs Zero
meta.short_description: Shadow Gangs Zero is an explosive 2D ninja action platformer with hand-drawn pixel art. Play as Dan or Monika, fight solo or together in 2-player local co-op, battle across 43 levels, unleash ninja powers, transform into powerful warriors, and face 6 challenging bosses and 6 massive mini-bosses.

meta.name: Junkyard Astronauts
meta.short_description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online multiplayer, built for 2–4 robots. Mac and PC together.

meta.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
meta.short_description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

meta.name: Vampy's Big Day
meta.short_description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

meta.name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
meta.short_description: Take on the role of one of the notorious Slaughter family, or their victims, in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film. Experience the mad and macabre for yourself in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

meta.name: Fran Bow
meta.short_description: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.

meta.name: That Which Remains
meta.short_description: 1–4 player sci-fi ghost-hunting horror extraction sim with proximity voice chat. Travel across time to extract resources, identify and capture hostile entities as fuel for a supposed future utopia. Speak to entities using your voice, upgrade your prison, craft tools, and meet a rising daily quota.

meta.name: Little Misfortune
meta.short_description: Led by her new friend, Mr. Voice, Misfortune ventures into the woods, where mysteries are unraveled and a little bad luck unfolds.

meta.name: MADiSON
meta.short_description: MADiSON is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

meta.name: We Happy Few
meta.short_description: From the independent studio that brought you Contrast, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England. Hide, fight and conform your way out of this delusional, Joy-obsessed world.

meta.name: Raging Loop
meta.short_description: The feast has begun, can you escape the village alive?

meta.name: Scorn
meta.short_description: Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.

meta.name: Ib
meta.short_description: A 2D exploration adventure game set in a creepy, mysterious art gallery.

meta.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
meta.short_description: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

meta.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
meta.short_description: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

meta.name: Soul Mates
meta.short_description: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

meta.name: INSIDE
meta.short_description: Hunted and alone, a boy finds himself drawn into the center of a dark project. INSIDE is a dark, narrative-driven platformer combining intense action with challenging puzzles. It has been critically acclaimed for its moody art style, ambient soundtrack and unsettling atmosphere.

meta.name: Jump King
meta.short_description: Take up the challenge and face true high-stakes platforming in Jump King! Struggle upwards in search of the Smoking Hot Babe of legend, but explore with care; a single missed jump could lead to a long fall back down...

meta.name: OFF
meta.short_description: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

meta.name: Kimodameshi Online
meta.short_description: Go live from a haunted school at night. The scarier it gets, the more viewers tune in. But one of you is a traitor. An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

meta.name: SONG OF HORROR COMPLETE EDITION
meta.short_description: A 3rd person, fixed-camera survival horror adventure. Fear the Presence, a mysterious entity you cannot fight: stay alert, hide, breathe slowly... Explore cursed places where unseen spirits and lost souls linger in a true horror story for the ages.

meta.name: Blasphemous
meta.short_description: Blasphemous is a brutal action-platformer with skilled hack’n slash combat set in the nightmare world of Cvstodia. Explore, upgrade your abilities, and perform savage executions on the hordes of enemies that stand between you and your quest to break eternal damnation.

meta.name: ELbab
meta.short_description: ELbab is a pixel-art roguelite set in an endless library. Choose tiles to progress through dungeon-like paths and enjoy a build-crafting experience similar to ARPG planning tools. All battles are automated, letting you relax with coffee, videos, or even other games while refining your build.

2287520.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2

meta.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2
meta.short_description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance.

meta.name: Stellacore Defense
meta.short_description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

meta.name: Special Delivery
meta.short_description: Take the night shift at a crusty motel with strange guests. They might be weird... or they might not be human. Use their odd behavior to deduce which guests are hiding their true forms. Features randomly generated guests and monster behavior.

meta.name: Xiangqi Traveler
meta.short_description: Chinese chess with superpowers. Roll dice across four seasons, collect 36 Stratagems that burn, freeze and turn enemy pieces, chain them into combos, then beat each boss at its own endgame puzzles. A cozy HD-2D pixel roguelite for Xiangqi fans and roguelite lovers alike.

meta.name: Crawling Desktop Pet
meta.short_description: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

5099530.name: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han

meta.name: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han
meta.short_description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

meta.name: SORTALIS
meta.short_description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

3636460.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!

meta.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
meta.short_description: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

meta.name: Curatio
meta.short_description: A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

meta.name: The Adventures of Portos
meta.short_description: "A 2D Platform hide and seek adventure"

meta.name: What The Cluck
meta.short_description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

meta.name: CHESS2
meta.short_description: CHESS, BUT... NO TURNS, NO CHECK OR CHECKMATE, CAN'T MOVE THE SAME PIECE TWICE, 10×10 BOARD, 2 EXTRA KNIGHTS & PAWNS, PAWNS MOVE IN ANY DIRECTION

meta.name: Tomorrow Never Comes
meta.short_description: Tomorrow Never Comes is a choice-driven first-person narrative thriller. Trapped in a time loop, Noah must relive the same day, manage his injuries, use items, unlock new paths, and discover multiple endings in his attempt to finally reach tomorrow.

meta.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
meta.short_description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

meta.name: Synapse Grid
meta.short_description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 19–26 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

meta.name: 迷失小镇
meta.short_description: Lost Town is a 3D roguelike survival shooter. Play as an armed girl in a corrupted abandoned town. Maps are random. Fight mutant hordes, earn XP, unlock random skills and upgrades, and build unique combat styles. Each run changes; death restarts. Find the escape route and uncover the town's secret.

meta.name: Mines & Meows: Cozy Minesweeper
meta.short_description: Play Minesweeper, draw adorable cats, and complete your cat collection! Unwind with relaxing music and feline friends by your side.

meta.name: Stick A Fork
meta.short_description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

meta.name: Poolrooms Museum
meta.short_description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

meta.name: Heretics Amulet
meta.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

meta.name: The Library Assistant
meta.short_description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

5004570.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together

meta.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
meta.short_description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

meta.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
meta.short_description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

meta.name: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades
meta.short_description: Slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

meta.name: Little Seed
meta.short_description: A little seed, a very big world. Ride the breeze, bounce from leaves and drift through 20 botanical landscapes in a gentle physics adventure. Find a place to put down roots. An optional breath into your microphone gives you a little lift.

meta.name: Cosmo Corgis
meta.short_description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

meta.name: Coins Must Be Made
meta.short_description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

meta.name: Stonk: Timing The Market
meta.short_description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

meta.name: Draftfall
meta.short_description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

meta.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
meta.short_description: A dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths, or leads to death.

meta.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
meta.short_description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

meta.name: Mafia: Night falls
meta.short_description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

meta.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
meta.short_description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

meta.name: Blackstar Ranger
meta.short_description: Blackstar Ranger is a high-octane and immersive first-person space shooter. From the seat of your advanced fighter, you will complete contracts for BLACKSTAR, the most esteemed Private Military Faction in the solar system. With 6DOF capability, you will battle threats throughout the system.

meta.name: Timberworks
meta.short_description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

meta.name: Fantasy World Manager
meta.short_description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

meta.name: Tidy Up Frat House
meta.short_description: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

meta.name: HardLuck
meta.short_description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

meta.name: ConEX
meta.short_description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

meta.name: Fractured
meta.short_description: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

meta.name: Crownmason
meta.short_description: Crownmason is a turn-based, castle-building autobattler: armies fight on their own, and only a dead king ends the match. Seven factions, a card draft, and matches against the AI, on LAN or online.

meta.name: Airport Contraband
meta.short_description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

meta.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
meta.short_description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

meta.name: INTUS

meta.name: Dugout Dice

meta.name: Idle Reef

meta.name: Chako

meta.name: The Kharzov Effect

meta.name: Fuel Station Simulator

meta.name: Super Retro Race

meta.name: CH13: Rest Stop

meta.name: Voxie Survivor

5264110.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator

meta.name: Breaking Intelligence

meta.name: Lotyas

meta.name: Lanternfall

meta.name: Trivasion

meta.name: Game World

meta.name: Depth Charge

meta.short_description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

meta.name: Arauto
meta.short_description: Arauto is a turn-based board game of territorial conquest for 3 to 6 players, online against friends or bots. Roll the dice, hold continents, trade cards and chase a secret objective on the real world map or in the mythic realms of Ancalora and Asterra.

meta.name: Recess of the Dead
meta.short_description: A first-person zombie sandbox for one player, set on a single bright seaside block. Hold off the horde, take paying jobs, race the gang and flatten crowds with whatever car you like. Sugar's the currency. And yes, the arcade still works.

meta.name: FreeSurf
meta.short_description: A free-roaming surfing game with 19 surf spots inspired by real-world locations, each with its own type of wave. Surf solo or with up to 8 players in multiplayer with proximity voice chat, explore different surfing conditions, perform tricks, and create your own surfboards.

meta.name: Prophet Margin
meta.short_description: How far can you push one trade route? Connect villages, trade resources, and find clever routes to bigger profits. A thinky strategy city-builder inspired by Euro board games. Grow your network, optimize every connection, and please the gods.

meta.name: Your Way Out
meta.short_description: Pushed into a manhole, you wake up in the sewers with nothing but a lighter. Scavenge the dark tunnels, sell your finds to Rattus the rat trader, upgrade your gear and find your way out before the flame dies.

meta.name: Elementys
meta.short_description: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

meta.name: Balingo
meta.short_description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

meta.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
meta.short_description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

meta.name: Gloombo
meta.short_description: Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion who works while you focus. Turn your focus time into things she can craft, build up her floating island, fulfill orders, discover new blueprints, and look after a friend.

meta.name: Dead Last
meta.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

meta.name: Soul Finders
meta.short_description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

meta.name: SIFT
meta.short_description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

meta.name: Needle: The 1% Challenge
meta.short_description: Find the needle. One needle is hidden somewhere in a haystack of one million straws. Dig through the pile by hand, feed the hay to the machine, upgrade your tools and search with a metal detector. No automation. No shortcuts. 99% will give up before they find it. Will you?

meta.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
meta.short_description: Jump endlessly upward and master your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Combine powerful augmentations to craft unique builds, and survive relentless hazards and monsters for as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are ever the same.

meta.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
meta.short_description: A whole city is buried under 118,000 pieces of rubbish. Clear it, sort it and get paid, then buy bigger machines that swallow whole piles as you drive. Every street you finish comes back to life — and nothing you clean ever comes back.

meta.name: Bon Appétit
meta.short_description: The restaurant promises every guest an experience that will never be repeated. You’re about to discover what it takes to keep that promise. A short, fully hand-drawn point-and-click horror experience.

meta.name: Rookie Rook
meta.short_description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

meta.name: Scraplings
meta.short_description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

meta.name: WordCrack
meta.short_description: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

meta.name: Friends Park
meta.short_description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

meta.name: FiND ME
meta.short_description: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

meta.name: Black Hole Simulator
meta.short_description: Gaze into nature's greatest abyss. Explore a real-time black hole simulation with true gravitational lensing, a volumetric accretion disk, orbiting worlds, and cinematic relativistic effects.

meta.name: Automotive Tycoon
meta.short_description: Build your automotive empire from 1890 to today. Design vehicles with historical components, manage factory production lines, research 50+ technologies across 7 eras, and compete in a dynamic global market spanning 130+ years of history.

meta.name: Blight Brigade
meta.short_description: A co-op extraction horror where your crew of plague doctors are sent back through time to investigate a blight that has consumed the future. Collect evidence of the blight and avoid the horrors that blight has created.

meta.name: Eris One Stand
meta.short_description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

meta.name: Roadkill
meta.short_description: The City Streets are Dangerous for a Single Raccoon! Dodge Vehicles, Scavenge Food, and Manage your Child's Insatiable Appetite!

meta.name: Phasmonauts
meta.short_description: Phasmonauts is a 4 player local co-op supernatural roguelite. Cryptid sightings are on the rise! It’s up to you and your friends to invent ghost-hunting equipment to solve the mystery and fight these supernatural creatures.

meta.name: Necrovoid
meta.short_description: Necrovoid — a dark post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with 2d6 turn-based combat. In a world shattered by nuclear fire and Rifts, you carry a Black Parasite in your chest. Every death makes you stronger… and less human.

meta.name: Space Travelers
meta.short_description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

meta.name: Echoes
meta.short_description: ECHOES is a short, atmospheric puzzle-platformer where every step brings you closer to a forgotten memory. Record your movements, create echoes of yourself, and uncover a story about time, memories, and letting go.

meta.name: World Rock Scissors Paper
meta.short_description: What if Rock Scissors Paper could be enjoyed for much longer? That simple thought inspired us to create this game. Choose your cards, bet your points, and battle 15 opponents. Use finger counts and card numbers to determine the winner, upgrade your cards, and fight your way to victory.

meta.name: The Florida Trail
meta.short_description: Escape Florida for cheaper rent in a choice-driven, pixel-art survival comedy. Pick a questionable vehicle, manage food, fuel and repairs, and gamble on roadside jobs and strangers. Reaching Georgia is one thing. Arriving with enough money to start over is another.

meta.name: COP BASTARD
meta.short_description: COP BASTARD is a classic FPS set in early ’90s Japan. Play as a tough detective and blast through waves of yakuza in relentless action inspired by ’90s films. No puzzles, perks or upgrades - just corridors, enemies and the chance to spit in their faces.

meta.name: Aethermancer
meta.short_description: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins, plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles, and watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

meta.name: Dinoblade
meta.short_description: Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. meta.name: Teamfight Manager 2

meta.name: Desktop Duck
meta.short_description: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

meta.name: The Roottrees are Dead
meta.short_description: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

meta.name: WhiteClothes

meta.name: Star Imperium

Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.

meta.name: Screen Monster
meta.short_description: A cozy desktop companion: pixel pets that lives on your real Windows desktop while you work. Pet them, toss toys, grow Bond to unlock new friends, spend Pet Points on food and toys, and jump into short mini-games with them whenever you need a break.

meta.name: I, Spy
meta.short_description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

meta.name: I Swear I Parked Here
meta.short_description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

meta.name: Yaoguai  Compendium
meta.short_description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

meta.name: MirrorBullet
meta.short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Place mirrors to turn the sentries' shots back on them. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth. Every par is proven minimal.

meta.name: BACK TOGETHER
meta.short_description: BACK TOGETHER is a chaotic co-op platformer where four players work together to overcome difficult stages. Pull each other together with ropes, merge into one, and overcome massive obstacles to test true friendship (and rage)!

meta.name: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
meta.short_description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

meta.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
meta.short_description: Sabotage or Mistake? A 4-player online party game mixing co-op action with social deduction. Three Crew work together while one hidden Spy sabotages the team. Read your friends’ moves and excuses, then face a final showdown shaped by your mission results.

meta.name: VampOS: Red Ledger
meta.short_description: Run a vampire corporation from within a blood-red operating system. Recruit thralls, harvest victims, design blood products, manage Suspicion, and sacrifice your company for permanent power in this dark management Incremental.

meta.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
meta.short_description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

meta.name: Boxed
meta.short_description: This is an adventure game with a little action and puzzle thrown in to spice things up a bit. Explore a strange new world (that is oddly familiar). Move around town and complete missions.. Bash the bad boxes and avoid getting boxed by them.

meta.name: Super Froppings

meta.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
meta.short_description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Launch and swing through challenging levels with precise controls and extreme momentum.

meta.name: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein
meta.short_description: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein is a top-down roguelite shooter. Pilot your mech deep into an alien vein — mine for fragments, build weapons and talents, and survive 20 waves and 5 boss fights to reach the core.

meta.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
meta.short_description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

meta.name: WARPROOF
meta.short_description: This is an empire simulator wich the decisions you take will impact on gameplay.

meta.name: Digital Romance Memoir
meta.short_description: A total-immersion kinetic novel: boot up a PC running Prisma OS and descend into the psyche of a broken protagonist as 2001 Argentina collapses in the background. Late-night chats, obsession, music, and raw Y2K bleakness.

meta.name: IAI // BREAKER
meta.short_description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

meta.name: Sudokiller
meta.short_description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

meta.name: Moonlit Horizons
meta.short_description: After you start seeing and hearing things, you receive an invitation to the First Continent. With only a small shack, a few seeds, and a handful of coins, a new life begins. Uncover Moonlit Cove’s secrets in a farming sim with surprise elements, where no two playthroughs are the same!

meta.name: Susanoo: Typing Action
meta.short_description: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

meta.name: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
meta.short_description: A tiny VPet device lives on your taskbar and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points, catch a box or a key every 30 minutes of play, open boxes on a spinning reel and collect 140 devices from 7 series, pets, straps and charms you can trade on Steam.

meta.name: GOOB8
meta.short_description: A Collection of PICO-8 Games that don't reach far. Find a game you like, and boot it up!

meta.name: Naughty Nurse
meta.short_description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

meta.name: Zero League
meta.short_description: Zero League - a cosmic football sim with vast real world tactics, trading and business environments. Sign players with celestial lore, dictate your formation in the midst of temporal disarray, and watch every match on an interactive 2D pitch impacted by galactic weather events.

meta.name: Phoning It In
meta.short_description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

meta.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
meta.short_description: Battle friends or bots in explosive 4-player local multiplayer across the vibrant world of Verdantia. Master powerups and unpredictable Chaos Mutators, conquer the Region Tour, and prove yourself champion of the MegaBlast Festival.

meta.name: Crack the Bills
meta.short_description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

meta.name: Bums Race Rats
meta.short_description: Race rats, bet on them while they run and throw junk at the competition. Gamble at the slots, bet on cockroach racing, wake the giant rat and feed the homeless for $1. A grimy online party game for 2–8 bums. Just don't come last: the plumber is watching.

meta.name: Mystic Realm
meta.short_description: Mystic Realm is an idle cultivation RPG about finding your way with a band of companions. Travel through a world of Chinese fantasy, follow the stories along the road, and grow together at your own pace.

meta.name: Cinderdelve
meta.short_description: Hire a crew of dwarves, split them over nine classes that each break rock their own way, and dig down through eleven levels under the mountain. Take the nine lost artifacts, raise a dwarf to godhood at the altar, then break into the Cinder Tyrant's throne room and take his hoard.

meta.name: AXE DESCENT
meta.short_description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

meta.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
meta.short_description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

meta.name: Tire Dealer Simulator
meta.short_description: Take over your father’s debt-ridden tire shop and turn it into a thriving business. Buy and manage stock, negotiate with customers, change and balance tires, hire mechanics, upgrade your shop, take on contracts, and make the financial decisions that determine your future.

meta.name: Business Rivals
meta.short_description: Compete against rival companies in a ruthless multiplayer business war. Build your corporation, hire employees, invest in legal and illegal operations, sabotage competitors, survive inspections, and become the richest entrepreneur in the city.

meta.name: UNDERDEEP
meta.short_description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

meta.name: Birthday Boy and Benny
meta.short_description: A turn-based RPG about eating lots of cakes, hanging out with your friends, writing haikus, hearing tons of dad jokes, and exploring a world full of unique characters. It's also about surviving child abuse, dealing with your crazy, mentally-ill mother, and dealing with the fact that nothing lasts.

meta.name: Gothic Kitty Cat Idler
meta.short_description: Collect adorable gothic cats in this spooky idle adventure! Receive a new cat summon every minute, discover Bronze, Silver, and Golden felines, collect mysterious treasures, customize your companions, and build the ultimate haunted cat sanctuary.

meta.name: TRENCHWORMS
meta.short_description: Dig, swing and blast through real-time worm battles. Choose from 26 weapons and fight on destructible maps or rope-focused arenas. Play a 15 mission campaign, battle bots, share a keyboard, connect 2-6 controllers, or take up to six players online.

meta.name: Hatch'n'Wall
meta.short_description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

meta.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
meta.short_description: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

meta.name: Pinballoid Crush
meta.short_description: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

meta.name: Where I am Not
meta.short_description: A dark fantasy visual novel about memory, choice, and hidden connections. Uncover secrets, meet unusual companions, and discover how much of the world around you can truly be trusted.

meta.name: The Last Day: What Remains
meta.short_description: A short, emotional point-and-click narrative where you explore a hand-drawn room, uncover memories through everyday objects, and make one final choice that ends the story.

meta.name: blockia
meta.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

meta.name: The Gardener
meta.short_description: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

meta.name: Pixel Exorcist
meta.short_description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of RPG's of the era.

meta.name: Road to FIRE
meta.short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

meta.name: OVERPAINT

In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

meta.name: Dig into the orefields
meta.short_description: A top-down action shooter with persistent incremental progression. Mine Venia's materials, fight the Klapperiden, upgrade your mining ship, and rebuild your crashed mothership piece by piece to escape the planet.

meta.name: Solo Tower Defense VR
meta.short_description: A single-player VR tower defense shooter. Warp between two lanes, shoot down incoming enemies, and defend the gate. Choose upgrade cards between waves to boost your firepower, projectile speed, and more. Designed for seated play and comfort, while keeping the defense fast-paced and intense.

meta.name: WORJONG
meta.short_description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

meta.name: SEAMARK

meta.name: My Gaming Shop
meta.short_description: Start from scratch and build the gaming shop of your dreams! Assemble your own PCs, stock the shelves, welcome your customers and expand your store to become the best in town.

meta.name: Facrobry
meta.short_description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

meta.name: TOWERMOUTH
meta.short_description: Two players, one couch, one tower that talks back. Evolve 20 weapons, rank up transformations that never cap, and face a Warden every fifth floor while the Tower mocks you.

meta.name: Butterfly Project
meta.short_description: Raise caterpillars, witness the metamorphosis, and complete your sanctuary in this relaxing butterfly-collecting game.

meta.name: PLEASE WAIT
meta.short_description: A comedy game about installing a game. Get the progress bar from 0% to 100% while the installer stalls, bargains, lies, makes you agree to agree, runs away from your cursor and refuses to finish. One window. One loading bar. Please wait.

meta.name: My Yokai Boyfriend: I LOVE RAMEN!

meta.name: THE GRAVES VIGIL

meta.name: The Golden Caravan

meta.name: Samota

meta.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
meta.short_description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

meta.name: TRIGGER DRAW

meta.name: Battle Bot Tactics
meta.short_description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

meta.name: Tidy Tech

meta.name: BOOTH BUTCHER

meta.name: How They Built the Pyramids

meta.name: District Null

meta.name: Ostfriesland Games

meta.short_description: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

meta.name: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
meta.short_description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

meta.name: Don't Make a Sound
meta.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.

meta.name: Malleus
meta.short_description: A roguelite carnival arcade where a simple game of strength becomes a fight for your soul. Face an eldritch Game Master, master his rigged Hi-Striker, strategize, bargain, and ring the bell—or lose your soul forever.

meta.name: Making Room?
meta.short_description: An unpaid-rent argument leads Var to a house book that changes her housemates whenever they cross the kitchen threshold. A short psychological horror visual novel about living together, resentment, and making other people easier to bear.

meta.name: Nonogram Detective
meta.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

meta.name: Coin Pusher Millionaire
meta.short_description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

meta.name: Iron Frame
meta.short_description: A bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, each one rewriting a rule of the run rather than its numbers. Ten guns across forty tiers, ten bosses to break, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Survive long enough and the swarm stops being the problem.

meta.name: Escalation Pending
meta.short_description: Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required. A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

meta.name: Fire Isle
meta.short_description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

meta.name: Patchy
meta.short_description: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.

meta.name: The orb
meta.short_description: A first-person puzzle game consisting of 13 levels, each hiding a unique challenge. Use your mind to open the next door.

meta.name: Kick The Wallet
meta.short_description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins. It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

meta.name: Jimothy's Adventure
meta.short_description: Play as Jimothy, a raccoon trying to keep his family fed. Raid trash cans, haul your loot home, and outsmart increasingly ridiculous patrols as a simple night of scavenging turns into an all-out raccoon hunt in this single-player stealth adventure.

meta.name: Gumball Hero
meta.short_description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before it’s too late.

4742500.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus

meta.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
meta.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

meta.name: Gemfire Survival
meta.short_description: Survive endless neon waves in this fast-paced arcade auto-shooter. Collect XP gems to evolve your build with game-breaking synergies, survive brutal 60-second boss cycles, and spend banked gems in an infinite permanent skill tree to push your next run even further.

meta.name: UNIT 44
meta.short_description: Five nights. Twenty containers. Count them. Log them. Submit your report. The manifest says twenty. You counted twenty-one. Dispatch doesn't want to hear about it. A PSX-style horror game about a job that doesn't add up — and the guard who worked it before you.

meta.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
meta.short_description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

meta.name: Corner TCG
meta.short_description: An idle game that sits in the corner of your screen where you open card packs, sell cards and buy upgrades

meta.name: Mouse Mortar CE
meta.short_description: Calibrate your cannon, ignite the D.A.N. thruster, and launch your aviator mouse into orbit! Master unique gravities across 9 celestial worlds, dodge lethal traps, chain kinetic boosts, and conquer global leaderboards in this high-velocity physics launch arcade.

meta.name: Shanking Simulator
meta.short_description: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.

meta.name: Wallbreaker
meta.short_description: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

meta.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
meta.short_description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

spy.publisher: Games Operators, GAMIKE, G-DEVS.com, HotBunny Spotlight

meta.name: HackHub - Ultimate Hacker Simulator
meta.short_description: Unravel cyber secrets and foil mass surveillance as a skilled hacker in Hackhub. Challenge authority, rewrite the rules, and emerge as the ultimate digital rebel.

3471290.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig

meta.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
meta.short_description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

meta.name: GloveUp!
meta.short_description: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

466130.name: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School

meta.name: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School
meta.short_description: Notorious cult-classic Korean horror. Sneak into school at midnight to return your sweetheart's diary and get caught in a terrifying game of cat and mouse. Explore haunted hallways, solve classic survival horror puzzles and escape the clutches of a killer Janitor who is out for your blood.

meta.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
meta.short_description: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?

meta.name: OneShot
meta.short_description: OneShot is a surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game with unique gameplay capabilities. You are to guide a child through a mysterious world on a mission to restore its long-dead sun. The world knows you exist.

meta.name: ANIMAL WELL
meta.short_description: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.

meta.name: Fortune Mill
meta.short_description: An incremental game where you must make $1,000,000 to escape! Throw darts, drop pachinko balls, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and discover powerful synergies as each new game affects all the others!

meta.name: Mixtape
meta.short_description: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

meta.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
meta.short_description: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.

meta.name: Ratatan
meta.short_description: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

meta.name: Stackade
meta.short_description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

meta.name: Apothecary Grounds
meta.short_description: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

meta.name: Rend
meta.short_description: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.

meta.name: Scared Puppies
meta.short_description: In Scared Puppies, you dive into the paws of adventurous puppies on a mission to find their lost owner. Set in a vibrant world, the game blends puzzle-solving with light adventure elements, promoting teamwork and clever strategy.

meta.name: Knight Survivor
meta.short_description: This is a survival game inspired by Vampire Survivors. This is a very simplified version.

meta.name: Boomsday
meta.short_description: Hordes of adorable animals and toys want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op or 2 on the couch.

meta.name: Talaire
meta.short_description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

meta.name: Bet Your Friends
meta.short_description: Shocking twist on Monopoly, your FRIENDS now become your prized ASSETS! BUY, WORK, BID or GAMBLE. First one to REACH $1,000,000 WINS! Have YOU ever bet with your FRIEND'S LIFE on the line?

meta.name: Stream Slayers
meta.short_description: Turn your Twitch chat into a party in Stream Slayers! Choose from 6 unique classes, level up, unlock powerful abilities, and work together to defeat increasingly powerful bosses. Your chat fights.

meta.name: Hollow Life
meta.short_description: A short first-person psychological horror game where a voice gives you daily instructions — watch television, take your medicine, tidy up. The more faithfully you obey, the more your apartment decays into something wrong.

meta.name: RaviWar 1: A Perfect Sonday
meta.short_description: A free first-person adventure of puzzles and precarious jumps. It is 2077. The world lives inside Takarek, a tower of 17,769 floors, and Consensus has decided what everyone in it thinks for forty years. You are twenty, new to the job of deprecating data. Tonight you keep one file to save the world.

meta.name: Voyager III
meta.short_description: Robert, a 25 year-old intern at the biggest name in Space Exploration, is tasked with managing the Voyager III, an experimental probe that can warp to distant stars and worlds in the name of exploration. But as the months pass, Robert begins discovering horrors he wasn't meant to see.

meta.name: This Code Echoes
meta.short_description: This Code Echoes is a 2.5D platformer using weapons with directional attacks and multiple weapon slots for great combos. Battle your way through levels and face the bosses and get thier drops to get stronger and find your ultimate build!

meta.name: Cryoborn : convergence
meta.short_description: A race against the cold. Face overwhelming enemy waves in an action roguelite where every run is a fight for power and survival. Grow stronger, master your abilities, and kill the final boss before the frozen world consumes you.

meta.name: Reversi2048
meta.short_description: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough — if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

meta.name: The delayed memory
meta.short_description: The Delayed Memory is a first-person psychological horror adventure set in a mysterious station between life and death. Explore the station, uncover clues, solve puzzles, and evade terrifying entities as you piece together your lost memories and discover the truth behind your identity.

meta.name: BEATVISTA
meta.short_description: For little ones and hardcore players alike. BEATVISTA is a rhythm game where every track, with music and video from AI video creators, gets a stage of its own. Play one-button mini-games or hammer through HELL charts on four keys, and rewind any tricky passage to practice.

meta.name: Metlivi Adventure
meta.short_description: Metlivi Adventure is a private 1–4 player collaborative narrative game where you create a story room, choose a character, write your actions, and shape an evolving shared adventure together with friends.

meta.name: Nightwire
meta.short_description: Wire up a data-theft rig, launder stolen bytes on a live black market, and climb the netrunner underworld one burned identity at a time — until a ghost of who you used to be logs on, learns how you fight, and comes for the only chair that fits one of you.

meta.name: La P'tite Box: Technodrama
meta.short_description: A top-down action game. Explore a fractured, chaotic world, scavenge for a new energy core, and fight off the twisted machine-flesh husks that hunt you—all before your dying bastion falls for good.

meta.name: Intergalactic Burger Joint
meta.short_description: Turn falling ingredients into a dinner rush. Match four, set up cascades, and serve hungry customers across six space restaurants. Work through 120 campaign orders, unlock a crew of chefs, or see how long you can keep the kitchen running in Endless.

meta.name: KRAPHIS : DRILLER
meta.short_description: Mining roguelite. The detector pulses. Dig deeper. Find it and it's yours. Fuel is your only limit. 2041 you're a contract driller for STRATUM Corporation. How deep you go, when you return every decision is life or death.

meta.name: LINETAIN
meta.short_description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

meta.name: Mafia Solitaire
meta.short_description: Defeat the mafia and restore justice! Solitaire with a mafia twist! Dive deep into 1920s Americana!

meta.name: My Little Game Room
meta.short_description: Turn your Steam library into a cozy game room. Display your game cases, decorate every corner, and view the unlocked achievements in your collection.

meta.name: Daydream and Her Lonely Isle
meta.short_description: A school romance visual novel featuring offline AI chat and character memories. Speak in your own words; preferences, shared moments, and plans carry into later conversations. Spend a year with four heroines on an island, and uncover the mysteries in their dreams.

meta.name: UNWELCOME
meta.short_description: UNWELCOME is a first-person horror adventure set in an isolated desert town. Explore unsettling locations, survive dangerous encounters, and uncover fragments of a forgotten past as the town grows more hostile with every step.

meta.name: Fast Point
meta.short_description: Fast Point is a pickup point business simulator where you start with a small location, a few shelves, and your first customers. Receive deliveries, organize packages in storage, hand out orders, process returns, and make sure the queue doesn't turn into chaos.

meta.name: Heads Up, Chefs!
meta.short_description: Your neighbors throw dinner off their balconies. Catch it midair with a gravity gun and get it into the pot before the order runs out. One pot, two orders, up to six pairs of hands. Rent is due in three days.

meta.name: DEN DEN BLOCK
meta.short_description: Telephone game, but you build with blocks. See a prompt, build it — the next player guesses what it is in one word, then builds from that word alone... then everyone watches the chain fall apart together. Somehow "cat" becomes "rice ball". Party madness for 3-8 players, online or on one shared PC.

meta.name: The Outlaw's Saloon
meta.short_description: A dusty town. A brand-new saloon. And a whole lot of trouble waiting inside. They say a group of beautiful women came from the Far East and opened the wildest saloon the frontier has ever seen. They sing Western K-Pop, pour the drinks, and run games that’ll test your aim, your luck, and your nerve.

meta.name: Arsmagia
meta.short_description: This is a fresh take on the action genre that fuses shooting mechanics with math puzzles. Spotting the weak points of approaching enemies requires quick and accurate calculations. Solve equations to create openings for attacks, defeat your foes, and aim for a high score.

meta.name: Incremental Donuts
meta.short_description: Start with one donut. End with a multidimensional bakery empire. Click, automate, expand, unlock the Research Lab, run a Storefront, and break through to the Donut Hole. A layered idle game that keeps unfolding new systems until your mouse screams for mercy.

meta.name: Wayward Wind
meta.short_description: A trading simulation traveling between cities to buy, sell, and profit from commodities in an ever-changing market, inspired by real-world commodity movements. Turn market knowledge, timing, and a little luck into profit as you grow from an ordinary trader into a master of commerce.

meta.name: Scales: Exiled Girl
meta.short_description: Raise a girl like never before! Experience the story through anime-style storytelling in a fantasy adventure romance game that blends character development, interactive choices, free exploration, and multiple endings.

meta.name: Lifers
