meta.name: ONE LAST BEAM
meta.short_description: Aim your flashlight. Let your weapons fire. Survive escalating zombie hordes in this objective-driven survivor roguelite. Restore the power grid, evolve your arsenal, and reach dawn—but brighter light attracts more danger.

meta.name: 4:12 AM
meta.short_description: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

meta.name: Demon Source
meta.short_description: Demon Source is a soulslike roguelike game with procedural generated dungeons. Try new builds each run. Gather the Source to unlock new items and abilities. Solve the mystery of seven inhabitants of the Church. Try the Ultimate Challenge with great classical music. It is made by one person!

meta.name: Constellations
meta.short_description: Connect the stars to reveal each constellation in a minimalist puzzle game inspired by all 88 real-world constellations. Revisit your discoveries in the Catalogue, play at your own pace and enjoy the journey through an imagined sky.

meta.name: Dead Sector
meta.short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

meta.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
meta.short_description: Tower Defense against massive zombie hordes. Build turrets, defend your tower, and discover roguelite and survivor-like progression.

meta.name: No Sleep Tonight
meta.short_description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

meta.name: Tessera
meta.short_description: A calm, craft-first jigsaw game. Feel every piece: seven interlocking cut styles across four board shapes, including grid, hexagonal, triangular, and organic Voronoi, from a few dozen pieces to 1,000+. Daily puzzles, shareable codes, and curated museum masterworks.

meta.name: PLOW
meta.short_description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

meta.name: Hearts Extreme
meta.short_description: The classic card game Hearts, rebuilt as a solo puzzle. Every level sets a different goal for you to hit. Ten decks, each built from a different set of cards, played at 4, 5 or 6 player tables. And a ranked game where you compete with players around the world.

meta.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
meta.short_description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

meta.name: Entropic Decay
meta.short_description: After being caught up in a mysterious experiment on an alien pathogen brought to earth on a meteor you gain unexpected abilities, but are now property of an unethical mega corporation hell bent on weaponizing the very thing that's keeping you alive. Survive a world falling into Entropic Decay.....

5319550.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex

meta.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
meta.short_description: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

meta.name: HAVKER-MAN X
meta.short_description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

meta.name: 1.44MB RESCUE
meta.short_description: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

meta.name: rest: in a dark room
meta.short_description: Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.

meta.name: NIGHTWARD
meta.short_description: Your mother was a night nurse. A month after her funeral, a hospital closed for twelve years calls your phone. Follow her route through Sislidere, one sealed building at a time, and learn who was kept awake there - and why. Some of them only move when you look away.

meta.name: Main Bastion
meta.short_description: As darkness deepens and monsters emerge from their shadowed dens, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread. Take command of the last bastion! Build cunning traps, merge towers, choose unique upgrade cards, and level up your defenders. Can you hold the walls against dragons and their hordes?

meta.name: Circuit Pulse
meta.short_description: Circuit Pulse is a circuit puzzle game. Route glowing energy through cables and components on a board. Split, merge, and time pulses to power targets and trigger chain reactions across a board of escalating challenges.

meta.name: The Crust
meta.short_description: Build and automate a lunar colony that Earth depends on. Mine regolith, run conveyor-and-drone factories above and below the surface, manage colonists, trade with rival Earth factions — and play a story campaign with multiple endings.

meta.name: Opus Magnum
meta.short_description: Opus Magnum is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem, Infinifactory, and SHENZHEN I/O. Design and build machines that assemble potions, poisons, and more using the alchemical engineer’s most advanced tool: the transmutation engine!

200210.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt

spy.developer: Wild Shadow Studios, Deca Live Operations GmbH
spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play

meta.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
meta.short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

meta.name: Goose Goose Duck
meta.short_description: Goose Goose Duck is a game of social deduction for up to 16 players. Players are separated into different groups that are each assigned a different objective. Complete your team’s objective to win!

meta.name: Lunacid
meta.short_description: Cast into the Great Well, unwanted by the world above. You delve the dark in search of the Old One, your last salvation. Lunacid is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by Shadow Tower and King’s Field.

meta.name: Is This Seat Taken?
meta.short_description: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

meta.name: Let's Build a Zoo
meta.short_description: It's time to Build a Zoo! Construct and decorate enclosures, buy and breed animals, hire zookeepers and vets... then try your hand at DNA splicing, and stitch together over 300,000 different types of animal. This can only go smoothly...

meta.name: Kotama and Academy Citadel
meta.short_description: In the Academy Citadel, strength reigns supreme: only the most powerful survive and thrive. Fight your way through the high-tech Academy in your quest to get the highest of honors for a student, and uncover secrets that can save it in its direst crisis in this 2.5D side-scrolling Metroidvania.

meta.name: Muse Dash
meta.short_description: Paradise of parkour & rhythm game ★★★ — Muse Dash!!

meta.name: Solarpunk™
meta.short_description: Solarpunk is a survival game in a technologically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and hop on your airship to explore distant islands in the sky.

spy.developer: Hollow Ponds, Richard Hogg, Talha Kaya

meta.name: Wilmot Works It Out
meta.short_description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

meta.name: SpaceEngine
meta.short_description: The world's first science-based photorealistic interactive 3D planetarium that models the entire Universe, using procedural generation for uncharted areas.

meta.name: Weeping Souls
meta.short_description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

meta.name: Heroes & Co.
meta.short_description: Hire the worst misfits in town and form the perfect team to face every disaster. Your mission? Survive one full week. Get ready for seven days of cascading emergencies, exhausted heroes, and impossible choices to save the day.

meta.name: ERLIK
meta.short_description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

meta.name: Dunjin
meta.short_description: Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

meta.name: Dialshift
meta.short_description: Dialshift is a fast score-chasing arcade game played on one relentless ring. Every turn is also a hit. Read the targets, choose your route, and hold your nerve as seven modes twist the rules.

meta.name: FAIL GAMES
meta.short_description: FAIL GAMES is a collection of brutally hard but simple minigames. Beat each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail and spend them on outfits and effects. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

meta.name: SUPER GAHAKU
meta.short_description: Draw directly in 3D space! Bring topics to life with your own 3D creations. Laugh at the hilarious results and guess what everyone was trying to draw! Imagination matters more than drawing skills. A party game where everyone can shine!

meta.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
meta.short_description: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

meta.name: Code of Shadows
meta.short_description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where you don't just deploy drones, you command them. Switch modes mid-fight, fuse drones into stronger ones, and cut through rift-spawned hordes across collapsing dimensions.

meta.name: Kamikaze Aliens
meta.short_description: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

meta.name: I Hate Scalpers
meta.short_description: I just hate scalpers. So I made a game about bonking them so they don't come back! Figure out who the scalpers and sitters are and BONK THEM! Duel people in Cut The Line and be the hero the city.

meta.name: Goninkan
meta.short_description: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

meta.name: Piratocon: Dig, Restore & Collect
meta.short_description: A cozy first-person collecting game. Dig lost model ships out of a sunny beach dune, rebuild each one on the shelf of her kind aboard an old galleon and scrub her back to her true colours. No combat, no rush, just sand, sea and a collection that grows a little every day.

meta.name: Sound System
meta.short_description: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

meta.name: 가문의 영광
meta.short_description: A single-player idle RPG with classic K-MMORPG spirit and no paid gacha. Switch between nostalgic and painted visuals, hunt manually or automatically, and grow through loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and family progression.

5105470.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-

meta.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
meta.short_description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

meta.name: Outbreak: Dead City
meta.short_description: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

meta.name: Lost Host
meta.short_description: Can a toy car become the hero of a video game? One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace. Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

meta.name: Wonderful Time
meta.short_description: Control time to manipulate the movement of objects in this third-person puzzle game. Use the flow of time to reach places that were once inaccessible. The reward you seek awaits you.

meta.name: Cold Rails
meta.short_description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

meta.name: Knight's Party
meta.short_description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

meta.name: Forged: Reconquest
meta.short_description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

meta.name: CRYMELIGHT
meta.short_description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

meta.name: Gloom Break
meta.short_description: A relentless action-puzzle game about escaping a strange pit.

meta.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
meta.short_description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

meta.name: Make it! Karaage
meta.short_description: Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge! Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!

meta.name: Nozile
meta.short_description: Nozile is a fast-paced hack-and-slash roguelike where you start with a fully realized build. Pick 2 styles, swap in real-time, absorb Stat Orbs directly from fallen enemies, and break the game in intense 5-minute runs.

3082430.name: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek

meta.name: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
meta.short_description: An epic action RPG with couch co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will throw swords, cast spells, vanquish armies and become heroes.

meta.name: Stack & Brew
meta.short_description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

meta.name: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse
meta.short_description: A short, singleplayer time-loop puzzle game in which you restore a lighthouse to prevent a shipwreck that has already happened. Hunted by shadows across an island, you unfold the lighthouse keeper’s tragic story and piece together a way to end the nightmare.

meta.name: LIMINOID
meta.short_description: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

meta.name: Mancalero
meta.short_description: Plan one perfect move and watch it chain into millions of points. Mancalero is a roguelike built on Mancala, the board game of moving stones from pit to pit. Collect marbles that burn, multiply and swallow whole pits, build a combo engine and climb 8 tables, each with a boss that changes the rules.

meta.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth
meta.short_description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

meta.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
meta.short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

meta.name: Echo Mates
meta.short_description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

meta.name: Starshapes
meta.short_description: A calm and highly satisfying puzzle game about connecting shapes to create 3D star constellations.

meta.name: Aetherantis Realm of Fates
meta.short_description: Aetherlantis is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory expansion and fate cards. meta.name: Linear Chess
meta.short_description: Chess on a single line of 21 squares. Rethink familiar tactics with adapted piece movement and win by checkmate or centre control. Play locally, challenge the AI or face another player online across four distinct 3D themes.

meta.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
meta.short_description: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

meta.name: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
meta.short_description: Rise from illegal underground bouts to bareknuckle champion in a single-player boxing career where damage carries from fight to fight and can bring your career to an early end. Fight, upgrade your gym, climb the rankings, and see how far you can make it.

meta.name: TinyBriks
meta.short_description: TinyBriks is a relaxing minimalist plastic brick building game where there are no objectives, no building instructions, no time pressure and no maximizing shareholder value. Make whatever YOU want. Create fantastic dioramas from a plethora of brick styles and colors. Your imagination is the limit.

meta.name: The Maze: In Dark
meta.short_description: With only a flashlight to rely on, secure your objective in the dark factory and escape while avoiding the gaze of 'Him', who roams the factory at random. Overcome the extreme fear of the unknown brought on by darkness and complete your assigned mission safely.

meta.name: Node Crown
meta.short_description: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here! Have fun!

meta.name: Way Too Many Eggs
meta.short_description: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

meta.name: just volleyball
meta.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

3339970.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones

meta.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
meta.short_description: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

meta.name: Good Boy, Good Girl!
meta.short_description: Train your loyal dog to fetch balls and frisbees across challenging parks, but watch out for wild dogs trying to disrupt your fun! Clear every park to reach the ultimate finale at the sunny beach.

meta.name: Souterrain
meta.short_description: Roll the dice. Cheat fate. Break the house. Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game where you manipulate colorful dice, build powerful combinations, and gamble everything on one more hand.

meta.name: Sushiamo
meta.short_description: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

meta.name: Village in Bloom
meta.short_description: Build a new life on Grandpa Rıza’s farm in this cozy, single-player farming adventure. Grow crops, care for animals, fish, cook, craft, and fulfill your neighbors’ letters and orders on the way to the village fair.

meta.name: Wickwood
meta.short_description: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. meta.name: Magic Clicker
meta.short_description: Blast through hordes with magic and grow wildly powerful! Play as Shiina in a mix of 3D action and clicker progression. Defeat enemies to upgrade and awaken spells, from Magic Ball to Laser Beam. Use Rebirth to grow stronger, and reach new heights of power with your little dragon companion!

meta.name: Heroes of Underhollow
meta.short_description: Descend into Underhollow, a turn-based tactical roguelike where the battlefield is your weapon. Ignite oil, electrify water, and shove enemies into hazards. Choose from three heroes, shape your build, and chart a dangerous route through four dungeon floors.

meta.name: Wildixir
meta.short_description: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

meta.name: High Lance
meta.short_description: Tap to flap. Higher lance wins. A one-button arcade game: ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges, unseat rival riders from above, and catch them as they parachute down to build a capture streak. Miss them, and they'll return a rank tougher. Five lands, each ending with a dragon.

meta.name: Axomorph Idle
meta.short_description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. meta.name: Sanslo:Spin of the Three Kingdoms
meta.short_description: A unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary generals, build your army, unleash outrageous fantasy skills, and conquer the battlefield with strategy and luck in every spin.

meta.name: Life Tycoon
meta.short_description: A life management sim where you start from nothing and face 365 days of work, study, and risky choices. Unlock careers, improve your home, and manage money, health, and mood. Can you build a better life without going broke?

meta.name: Wardspire
meta.short_description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

meta.name: Shorted
meta.short_description: Balatro-style scoring on a 9×9 grid. Your deck becomes the board: trace same-color Packets into scoring shapes, install Patches that hack the rules, and rebuild the deck that refills the grid. Six Firewalls stand between you and an overloaded high score.

meta.name: Turning Manor
meta.short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

meta.name: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper
meta.short_description: Slimes are invading your desktop, and every keystroke becomes a powerful counterattack. Unlock all kinds of weapons, draw wildly inventive artifacts, and collect strange and wonderful slimes. Fight alone or team up with friends to give the slimes a beating!

meta.name: Yukizuki no Seisou
meta.short_description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream… An adventure-type visual novel from VODALES.

meta.name: Prigod Idle
meta.short_description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

meta.name: Deuce Agency 2027
meta.short_description: Run a tennis agency, not a player. Scout unknown juniors, negotiate contracts and sponsorships, plan every player's season across a 52-week world tour, and give tactical orders between sets — a deep management sim built on how professional tennis really makes money.

meta.name: Bush League Baseball
meta.short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

meta.name: Cardsharp
meta.short_description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

meta.name: Diskette Dungeon
meta.short_description: A magical Diskette opens a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adapting, fighting, and collecting corrupted data to unlock the next world. With a wide variety of powers and weapons, every run offers a different challenge.

meta.name: Trolley Dilemma
meta.short_description: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

meta.name: Objecipher
meta.short_description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

meta.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
meta.short_description: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

meta.name: Spincremental
meta.short_description: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

meta.name: Warlapse
meta.short_description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

meta.name: Event Horizon Research
meta.short_description: A first-person sci-fi descent into a black hole. Study it from a research station, design and assemble your own capsule from real engines and hull materials, then pilot it through the accretion disk and past the event horizon. You have limited lives.

meta.name: Slumber Realm
meta.short_description: Battle your childhood fears in a 90s-soaked dice roguelike. One die roll triggers your entire build. Chain wild combos, fight broccoli, and decorate your bedroom with nostalgic relics.

meta.name: Marble Stars
meta.short_description: Marble Stars is a challenging platformer made by one person. Explore 55 handcrafted levels suspended above the ocean, discover special abilities, speedrun each course to compete on the global leaderboards, and earn prestigious medals as you progress.

meta.name: Cubus Tower
meta.short_description: Cubus tower is a platformer game. Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

meta.name: Lucky Shot VR
meta.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

meta.name: Compactor Baron
meta.short_description: Point and the hammer swings in this active incremental. Crush cans, toasters and safes into cubes, pay bills that grow as you earn, and build a bench of machines and a helper robot that work right alongside you.

meta.name: Noodle Cable
meta.short_description: The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

meta.name: Find The Box
meta.short_description: There is a box buried in a cube of a million blocks. Find it. Be Happy. Dig slow and relaxing, or fast and destructive: level up and pick spells and modifiers that change your playstyle. Beat your personal best, or race the world on global leaderboards. A cozy or crazy first-person digging game.

meta.name: The Curator
meta.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

meta.name: Old Man's Sushi
meta.short_description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

meta.name: Lazy Cat - Mini Game Collection
meta.short_description: Take a cosy break with cute cats and 14 mini-games, from classic puzzles and solitaire to arcade favourites. Enjoy charming stylised visuals, relaxing music, and day and night themes. Pick a game, settle in, and let the everyday rush fade away.

meta.name: Nine Provinces
meta.short_description: "The Nine Provinces" is an adventure-management text-based game. Set foot on the lands of the Nine Provinces, seek the ancient Nine Tripod Cauldrons, and encounter the moving tales that have been passed down through these realms. Different protagonists weave different stories.

meta.name: Block Guy
meta.short_description: Block Guys, giant walking war machines built from colored blocks, are marching on your base. Slide their blocks with the mouse, line up three or more of a color to clear them, and drop the Bloquians riding on top to the ground. Call in fire from your base and pop PSI balloons for special powers.

meta.name: Caesar: The Gallic Campaign
meta.short_description: 58 BC. You are a nameless ranker of Rome's Tenth Legion, crossing eight years of Caesar's Gallic campaign at spear height. No turns: one click is your movement and your strike. Build out of affixes and runes, hunt the titled elites, and see eight chapters through to the epilogue.

meta.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
meta.short_description: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

meta.name: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
meta.short_description: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

meta.name: Zombie BBQ House
meta.short_description: Zombie BBQ House is an online co-op restaurant sim for 1–8 players. Spot disguised zombies. Butcher, grill, serve. Hit the wrong person, the police come. Burn it, dinner hits back. Made money? Casino's across the street. With friends, someone's always slacking and someone's always causing trouble.

meta.name: TURF FIGHT
meta.short_description: Command specials. Command throws. In a beat 'em up.

meta.name: Scared Crow
meta.short_description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

meta.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
meta.short_description: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

meta.name: Thank You For Your Application
meta.short_description: Thank You for Your Application is a story-driven interview simulation game. After 15 rounds of interviews, you are reassigned as a junior interviewer, tasked with screening candidates’ resumes according to company requirements and issuing the appropriate thank letters.

meta.name: Streets of Rage 4
meta.short_description: Amongst the best beat’em up series ever created, jammin’ ‘90s beats and over the top street fighting, the iconic series Streets of Rage comes back with a masterful tribute to and revitalization of the classic action fans adore.

627690.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play

meta.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG

meta.name: Hero Siege
meta.short_description: Hero Siege is a fast paced Pixel Art ARPG featuring an expansive roster of unique classes, deep build experimentation, and a player driven economy.

meta.name: Overcooked! All You Can Eat
meta.short_description: Experience all the Onion Kingdom has to offer, Overcooked! 1 & 2 infused with 4k goodness running at a smooth 60 FPS. Fully remastered and cooked up from scratch. Enjoy 200+ levels (22 new) and 80+ chefs (3 new), this is the ultimate Overcooked! experience.

meta.name: Snow Resort Simulator
meta.short_description: Start with nothing but a ticket booth in the mountains. Clear snow, chop wood, crack ice off rooftops, all by hand, all in first person. Serve drinks, cook meals, repair ski gear, and turn a rundown mountain stop into a full-blown resort with a hotel, restaurant, bar, and shop.

meta.name: The Message from Deep Space
meta.short_description: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

meta.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
meta.short_description: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

meta.name: Neuroflip
meta.short_description: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

meta.name: Camera 5
meta.short_description: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

meta.name: Stellar Smash
meta.short_description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

meta.name: Desktop Wallet Heroes
meta.short_description: An intense idle RPG that unfolds right on your desktop! Desktop Wallet Heroes is an overlay idle RPG where characters endlessly hunt monsters at the bottom of your screen—without ever interrupting your work or web browsing. Continuously upgrade items to defeat enemies and rake in mountains of loot!

meta.name: Storm Grill
meta.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

meta.name: Digging Up Together
meta.short_description: Dig up the Egyptian desert. Sweep with a metal detector, shovel and drill through the layers in 1–4 player co-op, brush off ancient treasures and real-size dinosaur bones, haul them home by wheelbarrow or minecart, and build your own museum.

meta.name: In Full Bloom
meta.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

meta.name: FLIP OVER
meta.short_description: FLIP OVER is a puzzle game where you flip tiles to turn every tile white. Flip tiles with different rules and enjoy puzzles in many forms.

meta.name: Retail Nation: My Supermarket
meta.short_description: Build, customize and manage your own supermarket in this first-person retail simulation. Order stock, fill shelves, serve customers, manage and develop employees, and grow a small shop into a thriving supermarket.

meta.name: Monster Club League Manager
meta.short_description: Take charge of a monster club and aim for the Division 1 title in this single-player management sim. Recruit and develop players, choose a nine-monster lineup, and manage contracts, transfers, and club finances. Matches play out automatically as you build your squad over many seasons.

meta.name: fanxiu
meta.short_description: Fan Xiu is an idle cultivation game. Break through realms while elixirs, artifacts, and rare treasures drop over time. Every item you earn can be freely listed and traded on the Steam Market — idle your way to immortality, and to real profit. Limited-time events regularly drop exclusive items

meta.name: False Feed
meta.short_description: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different angles in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

meta.name: DeepCorp Rescue
meta.short_description: DeepCorp Rescue is a physics-based arcade rescue game where you pilot a fragile rocket through dangerous caves, dodge traps, save workers, recover cargo, and land safely. Upgrade your ship, master tricky missions, and survive DeepCorp’s hazardous underground world.

meta.name: PlayASM
meta.short_description: Build a computer from the inside out. Write real assembly, watch every register and byte change live, then draw graphics, compose chiptune music, program a robot arm and build 3D voxel worlds. 100+ missions. Full mod support. No black boxes.

meta.name: MONO CHAMELEON
meta.short_description: Hide-and-seek, tag and prop hunt with a retro handheld look in four shades of olive and cream. Paint yourself into the walls, drop decoys, or slip from shadow to shadow in Tag. 2–10 players, 5 modes, bots. Built for streams: 239 audience seats, viewer votes and turns, plus a director mode.

meta.name: THE UNREMEMBERED
meta.short_description: A dark fantasy, choice-driven roguelite. The king died without an heir, four great houses and the court are fighting over the throne, and you're a sellsword who belongs to none of them. Swipe left or right to take or refuse jobs, and your choices change the events and endings that follow.

meta.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
meta.short_description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

meta.name: BIGGER BANG
meta.short_description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

meta.name: Cuby Clicker
meta.short_description: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

5396310.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took

meta.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
meta.short_description: Beat a hero. Steal their skill. Turn it on the next one. A hands-on 2D pixel-art action roguelite: 13 heroes, 52 skills to steal and 34 special augments to stack into a broken build. No levels, no XP — only what you take.

meta.name: ZERO VISIBILITY
meta.short_description: Survive one day at a time in a fog-drowned American town overrun by the dead. Scavenge for supplies, get back to base before dark, take in survivors and hold off night raids. Every sound draws them closer. Find five fragments of research data to learn what happened here.

meta.name: Another Cat`s Tale
meta.short_description: A girl named Anna hides in a cursed mansion where the all-knowing Cat brought a fairy tale with no ending. He is patiently waiting for someone to finish it. In this first-person adventure, Anna must explore the mansion, solve puzzles, fight, and finally uncover its secrets.

meta.name: LINE WARLORD
meta.short_description: A real-time lane-defense roguelite. Spend rations to send troops down the line, stack relics, promote your units, and break the enemy stronghold with a different army every run.

meta.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
meta.short_description: A casual Texas Hold’em game with solo runs and online play for 2–8 players on Steam. One-time purchase, no paid chip top-ups. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

meta.name: Unpredictable Cake
meta.short_description: A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

5045430.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn

meta.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
meta.short_description: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.

meta.name: 魔女牌Witch Card‌
meta.short_description: As a Witch Intern, you will engage in card duel exams with the two witch examiners Little Red Riding Hood and Alice, using your starting deck, treasure cards, passive skills and divination. You need to clear 10 floors to become an official witch.

meta.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
meta.short_description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

meta.name: Continuum
meta.short_description: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

meta.name: Voxotron
meta.short_description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

meta.name: Zukontide
meta.short_description: Swarm-scale tower defense: up to 40,000 aliens per siege, thousands on screen, physically crushing into your chokepoints. You are expected to fall — every kill banks credits, even in defeat. Grind the war economy, research deadlier guns, mount them on the ruins, and return to hold the line.

meta.name: Overtime : Development Hell
meta.short_description: Play as Frank, a developer at a highly secretive game development studio rushing to finish the studio's most anticipated release, while being disrupted by an obsessed fan trying to gain information on the long awaited game. Survive Frank's final night alone in this Psychological Horror experience.

meta.name: Novalex Project Zero
meta.short_description: A turn-based car-company tycoon. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, undercut on price, and out-engineer a field that grows to 30 AI rivals across a century of motoring. Build the carmaker that lasts, or go bankrupt trying.

meta.name: Moon Swarm
meta.short_description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

meta.name: Coverage
meta.short_description: Grow to cover the board with your pieces--or absorb all of your opponent's. A board game similar to Othello and Ataxx, playable by up to 2 players online or offline, with a built-in board editor and 3 game modes! Relax with a classic experience or try a fast-paced simultaneous movement mode!

meta.name: Trust Me, It Binds
meta.short_description: A procedural deckbuilder where you build real molecules and sell increasingly questionable confidence. Play cards, chase the target, stack absurd bonuses, and turn strange chemistry into an irresistible valuation. Nobody really understands molecules. Fortunately everyone understands numbers.

meta.name: Nonet Concerto R
meta.short_description: Blast through hordes of monsters with magic in this third-person 3D loot action game. Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and take on 50+ stages solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Stream on Twitch or YouTube and your viewers' chat can trigger monster reinforcements and storms.

meta.name: Dark Alley
meta.short_description: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

meta.name: Moto Rogue
meta.short_description: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

meta.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
meta.short_description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

meta.name: Spring Breeze Shokudo
meta.short_description: 1978, southern Taiwan. Come home to reopen your grandmother's shuttered shokudo: shop the morning market, set the menu, hire staff and win the street back from the flashy restaurant across the road. Currently available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese only.

meta.name: KPOP Idol Factory
meta.short_description: Form your own K-pop group – and live through fresh drama every day. Scout talent, plan training and comebacks, battle rivals on a 3D stage and make choices that change careers. It doesn't end at debut: your story runs through three acts all the way to the world tour.

meta.name: Nova Survivors
meta.short_description: Blast through endless alien hordes in space and climb the Steam leaderboards. Pick from 21 ships, each with its own weapon and ultimate, stack cards and weapon evolutions, and push through a 100-level campaign or endless Survival until your build breaks the game.

meta.name: Build A Bot
meta.short_description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

meta.name: Tzelem
meta.short_description: The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.

meta.name: Ragdoll Robotics
meta.short_description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

meta.name: Rosavane Borers LLC
meta.short_description: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

meta.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
meta.short_description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

meta.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
meta.short_description: A binary decision-driven city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

meta.name: Table Of Truth
meta.short_description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

meta.name: Faraway
meta.short_description: Faraway is an endless procedurally generated, mastery-driven arcade game about a shooting star that creates constellations to stay alive.

meta.name: Rogue Belt
meta.short_description: Fight through a storm-wracked asteroid belt in this top-down space roguelite, solo or in online co-op. Mix ships and weapons, choose an upgrade every minute, and face the boss after ten minutes. Break through to unlock new ships, weapons, and permanent upgrades.

meta.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
meta.short_description: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

meta.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
meta.short_description: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

meta.name: Chivalware
meta.short_description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

meta.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
meta.short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

meta.name: The Cruel Guardians
meta.short_description: Your manor is threatened from every side by brigands, anarchist revolutionaries, and a demigod. Will you resort to forbidden magic or pray for divine aid? An interactive fantasy novel, 181,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

meta.name: Soar Up The Charts
meta.short_description: A fast-paced rhythm game and arcade-style rail shooter where music is your weapon! 🎸With tracks provided by Alden Ave and Keep Flying, be ready to turn it up and blast your way through those radio robots! 🎺

meta.name: Performance Review: Survivor
meta.short_description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

meta.name: Last Inspection
meta.short_description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside — all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

meta.name: PHUY
meta.short_description: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

meta.name: MUPO
meta.short_description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

meta.name: Sheepscape
meta.short_description: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

5247120.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue

meta.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
meta.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

meta.name: Gold Miner Online: Claw Chaos
meta.short_description: Swing, drop, grab! The classic gold-mining arcade game goes online. Race up to 3 rivals in ranked or private matches, or dig through 60 levels, 6 worlds and bosses. Four claws. Total chaos.

meta.name: PIX Football Manager
meta.short_description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

meta.name: Sheep Go!
meta.short_description: Ram, punch or fire cannons! Sheep Go! is a plush-style action roguelite. Mix wool-ball throws, static charge from rubbing, Sheep Shadows and summoned flocks of sheep into your own build. Become a little sheep on a journey from farm to town to rescue Mom, with surprises along the way.

meta.name: Penguin Colony
meta.short_description: Send your penguins waddling off to gather pebbles, fish the Shore and grow a bustling colony. Buy upgrades until the whole flock works on its own, then Migrate for Feathers and come back stronger. A cosy incremental game with a real ending, and an Endless mode if you never want to stop.

meta.name: 浴血淞沪
developers: 重庆灵溪网络科技有限公司
publishers: 重庆灵溪网络科技有限公司
meta.short_description: Command Chinese troops in a 2D single-player real-time tactics game set during the 1937 Battle of Shanghai. Deploy infantry and heavy weapons, direct your defenses, and personally aim mortars as you face armored assaults, air raids, and amphibious landings.

meta.name: Sort Them Fish
meta.short_description: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

meta.name: Gold Express
meta.short_description: Jump gaps, grind rails and land flips in a fast-paced minecart runner. Collect gold, upgrade your gear and unlock carts, characters and hats as you ride through different biomes. Watch out for the Danger Train!

meta.name: Hoof Trimmer Simulator
meta.short_description: Clean, pare and treat sore cow hooves in a cozy barn. Scrape off the crust, carve satisfying horn curls, find the abscess with hoof testers and release the pressure — then watch your patient walk away sound. Nine breeds, endless cases, oddly satisfying.

meta.name: Type Me Home
meta.short_description: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

meta.name: Holdopolis
meta.short_description: One toilet. An entire city desperate to use it. Build districts, draw queues, deliver paper and haul away waste. Handle breakdowns, strikes and elections in a satirical city builder where one locked door can bring everything to a standstill.

meta.name: DERAIL
meta.short_description: DERAIL is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with your camera to escape the loop.

meta.name: Great Achievements
meta.short_description: Great Achievements is an online multiplayer role-playing game that takes you to an epic world filled with swords and magic. Choose multiple roles and form your own team. Explore the vast continent with friends, challenge legendary dungeons, and write your own adventure legends.

5066680.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches

meta.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
meta.short_description: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a true 4v4 team esport. Across a shared central Nexus, pieces invade neighboring boards to flank opponents and rescue allies in synchronized team volleys. It's the world's first true multi-board competitive team chess.

meta.name: DriveGear
meta.short_description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament. Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

meta.name: Idle Golf
meta.short_description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

meta.name: Not My Son
meta.short_description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

meta.name: Traders Life Simulator
meta.short_description: Run your own shop in a first-person trading sim where you buy low, negotiate smart deals, and sell for profit.

meta.name: Wildacre: Farm Life Simulator
meta.short_description: Build a homestead on a wild island in first person. Till, plant and water your fields, chop timber for a log cabin and hunt the forest with a bow. Seasons shift market prices, rain waters your crops, and well-tended fields can yield gold-quality harvests.

meta.name: Pre-Warp Age
meta.short_description: A turn-based economic strategy game about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Plan the development of your colonies, assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems.

meta.name: A Little Faraway
meta.short_description: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

5302490.name: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread

meta.name: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
meta.short_description: You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb — through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs. Start with one.

meta.name: Hazzard Hearth
meta.short_description: Survive the known (hunt, craft, fish, treat illness, mend bones, ration supplies, wolves, bears) and unknown (volatile weather, mutated beasts), stranded on a mountain. Solve the mystery and try to re-establish communications for rescue. Free roam or follow the story. Play single player or co-op.

meta.name: AI Clicker
meta.short_description: Click Your Way to World Domination (Or Doom)! Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter… or creates a future where AI replaces you!

meta.name: Dictatorship Simulator
meta.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about manipulating a political simulation and becoming a dictator. Change how the political system works so it tears itself apart. 5% of profits donated to the godot and blender foundations.

meta.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
meta.short_description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.
